_how_to_fill: Roblox's own attachment for each of David's hairs (specs/characters/head-roblox.md). import_hair.py attaches every hair with it, and re-running import_hair.py refits, re-maps, rebuilds LOD 1 and syncs everything; no other step.

To fill an entry from Roblox Studio: insert the accessory (Toolbox > Inventory, or Avatar > Accessories), expand it, select Handle > HairAttachment, and copy its Position (x, y, z, studs) and Orientation (x, y, z, degrees) from the Properties window into 'position' and 'orientation'.

mesh_scale: if the Handle has a SpecialMesh child, its Scale (x, y, z). If the Handle is a MeshPart, Size divided by MeshSize: in the command bar, print(game.Selection:Get()[1].Size / game.Selection:Get()[1].MeshSize) with the Handle selected.

Then set 'provisional' to false and 'source' to 'Studio'. Entries with provisional true are estimates: hair/seat_fit.py rewrites their position from the hair's shape (it never touches an entry with provisional false).
frame: Roblox units and axes (studs; the HairAttachment's Position and Orientation in its Handle, as Studio shows them). The head side is Roblox's classic head, whose HairAttachment is its top centre (head_shape.HAIR_ATT); 1 stud = head_shape.STUD m.
